summary.text: Jodey Arrington was raised in Plainview, Texas, and graduated from Texas Tech University.

paragraphs.text: He worked for Gov. George W. Bush, then as a senior advisor in the Bush White House and as chief of staff to the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.
He returned to West Texas in 2007 as Vice Chancellor of the Texas Tech University System and, in January 2017, began representing Texas's 19th Congressional District.
